# Recursive MSI fixture

`recursive.msi` is generated by this project from `recursive.wxs` and the
minimal PE/MSI seeds under `fuzz/corpus/`. It contains two embedded cabinets,
a Binary-table PE stream, an ordinary text file, and a nested MSI that stays
untouched. The tiny PE stubs are parser fixtures, not runnable programs.

Regenerate it from the repository root with msitools (`wixl`, `msibuild`) and
`gcab` installed:

```sh
python3 tests/generate_recursive_fixture.py
```

Signing interoperability tests replace the PE stubs with the unsigned PE
fixture from the recorded `modules/osslsigncode` submodule and a copy signed
with an ephemeral test certificate. No production signing identity is used.
